lessons_used: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though some changes like compact layouts outperformed predictions.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in 2 winning tests, though one specific placement hurt.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) either hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) were helpful in 1 winning test, while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for all change kinds tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests to state a rule.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Story Scroll Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen with a vertical story scroll layout that displays pet traits and animated previews.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the core funnel (62.1%) with an 89s median completion time, showing friction during pet evaluation.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick friend screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step, but redesigns require heavy effort and show modest +0.7% historical lift.

candidates.title: Welcome Story Companion Choice Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new story intro screen immediately after the story screen to set companion expectations before path selection.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s and a drop-off rate of 23.9%, indicating initial hesitation before choosing an adoption path.

new_story_intro.headline: Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion
new_story_intro.body: Your pet will live right on your desktop. Choose how you want to create your companion today.

guard.reason: Adding a new story intro screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens before path selection tends to add friction and lower conversion.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Pet Pick Screen
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur right after selecting a pet from the pick friend screen.
candidates.why: Support emails show 8 reports of missing/reset pets after sign-in. Asking users to sign in after picking their pet establishes clear ownership before photo/certificate creation.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails and positive historic track record for sign-in reordering (+0.7%).

candidates.title: Desktop Interactive Companion Audio Onboarding Flow
candidates.change: Introduce an interactive sound component on the final intro screen allowing users to trigger test audio clips of their pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to interact with or talk to the pet, and the finish step suffers a 64.8% drop with a 5815s mean duration.

guard.reason: Adding an interactive sound component to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from funnel and support, but introducing new flows on finish step historically drops conversion by -3.2%.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Interactive Animation Progress Display
candidates.change: Add an animated progress element and step counter component during the pet generation wait screen.
candidates.why: The home wait step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing 15.6% of users to drop out before completion.

guard.reason: Adding animation and step progress during the real pet creation wait is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Wait info progress displays on home step have a reliable history of positive lift (+1.5% average).

candidates.title: Upload Photos Two Column Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Change the upload photos screen layout to a two-column view separating photo submission from formatting tips.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet photo creation issues, and adoption step drop-off remains high at 37.9%.

guard.reason: Changing the layout of the upload photos screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high drop-off and support issues, but layout changes historically yield slightly negative results (-0.6%).

candidates.title: Story Screen Quick Setup Welcome Copy
candidates.change: Update story screen headline and body text to highlight the fast and simple 2-minute setup process.
candidates.why: Choose path takes an average of 514s, indicating users pause to evaluate commitment before starting.

story.headline: Adopt Your Desktop Pet in 2 Minutes
story.body: Pick a companion, customize its appearance, and bring it to life on your desktop.

guard.reason: Updating copy on the story screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Very low cost text tweak, but choose_path copy changes previously resulted in a -4.7% drop.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Sync Helper Text Hint
candidates.change: Add a text component hint clarifying that signing in backs up the pet profile across app restarts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.

components.text: Signing in connects your pet to your account so progress is saved securely.

guard.reason: Adding helpful account sync text to sign-in is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 8 user emails and very cheap to add, though copy/hint tweaks on sign-in average -0.6%.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Bonus Skin Incentive
candidates.change: Add a prominent badge component on the home intro screen showcasing an unlocked bonus pet skin.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with extremely high mean completion time (5815s), requiring stronger motivation to finish setup.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions bonus items, violating the rule against mentioning free extras or gifts.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Instant Processing Confirmation Notification
candidates.change: Add a badge component on the photo upload screen confirming instant automatic image processing.
candidates.why: 3 support emails highlighted custom pet rendering failures, causing user anxiety during photo upload in the adoption step.

guard.reason: Adding a verification status badge to photo upload is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost badge component addressing severe drop-off step with strong support mail alignment.
